subject: Mathematical Statistician position available in Forest Service Research

messages.author: 247b990d236a7af6
messages.subject: Mathematical Statistician position available in Forest Service Research
parts:
About a year ago I sent an "outreach" message to this group and we have finally got the job posted as of tomorrow (Friday, August 12, 2016).  We have a GS-12 Mathematical Statistician position at our Pacific Southwest Research Station.  The location of the job is still to be determined:  Albany, Arcata, Davis, Placerville, Redding, or Riverside, California.

The position performs statistical consulting and statistical reviews of manuscripts and study plans in support of the Station's research efforts in trees, fire, endangered species, invasive species, water, birds, small mammals, urban/wildlife interface, and a whole lot more.

If you'd like to apply please use this link https://www.usajobs.gov/GetJob/ViewDetails/447476100 or search USAJobs.gov.

Note that the salary will depend on what city is chosen by the selecting official.  (This is because different localities are paid differently in the Federal government.)

An application must be submitted (following the instructions on the link - please don't send any applications to me) by Monday, August 22.  That's only 11 days away.

If you know anyone who might be interested in this position, please forward this information to them.

Thanks,

Jim

Jim Baldwin
Station Statistician
USDA Forest Service
Albany, California
